title: A bare position carries no prior occurrences: the repeated position of mx-chk-001 supplied with no history is ongoing
rationale: This start_fen is byte-identical to the result_fen of mx-chk-001, which the contract rules a loss for the checking side at the third occurrence of the position. Here the same position record is supplied bare: Black is in check from the d4 chariot and has exactly one evasion, since d6 stays on the checked file and e7 would face the kings on the empty e-file. A perpetual-check violation is only complete when a position stands on the board for the third time with the violation sustained across its occurrences, and a bare position carries no prior occurrences, so no violation exists here and the game is ongoing. A live check with no history is not a perpetual check.
